title: 第28章 老鬼的要求
novel_title: 苟道剑尊：从反夺舍老祖开始长生
content_zh:
陈凡收起令牌，跨步走入万鬼楼。

    楼内光线阴暗，空气中燃着一种能够安定心神却略显阴冷的奇特灵香。陈凡顺着一侧的黑木楼梯一路来到阁楼三层。

    刚一踏入三层的玄关，一股庞大到令人窒息的恐怖威压便如同排山倒海般席卷而来。

    这股威压极其凝练，带着筑基后期修士特有的浑厚与阴寒，压得陈凡身体周围的气流都发出了阵阵不堪重负的爆鸣。

    陈凡藏在乌木面具下的脸色波澜不惊。

    他体内的《玄金诀》法力在经脉中平稳流转，没有露出一丝异样。

    至于神魂，他吞噬了林家老祖的残魂，神识强度远超同阶，区区筑基后期的精神威压，根本无法动摇他分毫。

    不过，为了符合自己此时炼气八层的散修身份，陈凡还是故意将肩膀微微一沉，脚下向后退了半步，装出一副法力不济、脸色苍白的惊恐模样。

    “哈哈哈哈，小友果然好胆色，短短几日便敢来寻老夫。”

    威压骤然收敛。

    阁楼深处的软榻上，身穿邋遢道袍的老鬼正咬着一根不知名妖兽的烤腿，嘿嘿低笑着看向陈凡。

    老鬼抹了一把嘴上的油渍，眼神中闪过一抹深意：“老夫这万鬼楼的三层，寻常炼气后期修士一进来便会双腿发软。你小子虽然退了半步，可体内的灵力却连一丝紊乱的迹象都没有，看来老夫那天在柳溪镇确实没有看错你。”

    陈凡走到老鬼对面的石椅上坐下，声音沙哑：“老前辈既然留了令牌，晚辈自然要来。只是不知，前辈说的更大池塘，在哪？”

    老鬼收起了脸上的嬉笑，将手中的骨头往桌上一扔，一双浑浊的眼睛里陡然射出两道宛如实质的精光。

    “这万鬼楼，便是这更大的池塘。小子，老夫明人不说暗话。老夫这几天动用各方渠道查过你。”

    老鬼开门见山，声音在空旷的阁楼内回荡，“临泉郡的散修名册里，可查不到你这么一号手艺精湛的金属性炼器师。倒是隔壁青阳郡那边，半年前林家覆灭的时候，据说跑出了个身怀金灵根的年轻天才。”

    说到这里，老鬼盯着陈凡的面具，嘿嘿笑道：“不过你放心，老夫开门做生意，专讲利益和承诺，从来不问雇主的来历。那些修仙家族和血煞门的悬赏，在老夫眼里连个屁都不算。”

    陈凡不承认，也不否认。

    他只是平静地看着老鬼，淡淡开口道：“前辈既然说讲大利益，那便谈谈合作吧。晚辈需要临泉郡内最高规格的情报渠道，以及大量二阶矿石和进阶资源的变现路子。作为交换，晚辈可以为万鬼楼提供高品质的一阶极品法器修补与定制。”
content_en:
Chen Fan put away the token and stepped into Wangui Tower.

    The light inside the building is dim, and there is a strange spiritual fragrance in the air that can calm the mind but is slightly cold. Chen Fan followed the black wooden stairs on one side to the third floor of the attic.

    As soon as he stepped into the entrance hall on the third floor, a suffocating and terrifying pressure swept over him like an overwhelming force.

    This coercion was extremely condensed, with the richness and coldness unique to monks in the late stage of foundation building. It suppressed the airflow around Chen Fan's body and made bursts of overwhelming explosions.

    Chen Fan's expression hidden under the ebony mask was calm.

    The "Xuanjin Jue" mana in his body flowed smoothly through his meridians without showing any signs of abnormality.

    As for the soul, he devoured the remnant soul of the ancestor of the Lin family, and the strength of his consciousness was far higher than that of the same level. The mental pressure in the late stage of foundation building could not shake him at all.

    However, in order to be consistent with his identity as a casual cultivator at the eighth level of Qi Refining at this time, Chen Fan still deliberately lowered his shoulders slightly and took half a step back, pretending to be frightened with a pale face and weak magic power.

    "Hahahaha, my little friend is really brave. He dared to come looking for me in just a few days."

    The pressure suddenly subsided.

    On the soft couch deep in the attic, an old ghost wearing a sloppy Taoist robe was biting a roasted leg of an unknown monster, looking at Chen Fan with a low smile.

    The old ghost wiped the grease on his mouth, and a hint of deep meaning flashed in his eyes: "I am on the third floor of the Ten Thousand Ghosts Building. Normally, as soon as a monk in the late stage of Qi refining comes in, his legs will become weak. Although you kid took half a step back, there is not even a trace of disorder in the spiritual power in your body. It seems that I did not misjudge you that day in Liuxi Town."

    Chen Fan went to sit on the stone chair opposite the old ghost and said in a hoarse voice: "Since the old man left the token, the junior will naturally come. I just don't know where the bigger pond the senior mentioned is?"

    The old ghost put away the smile on his face, threw the bones in his hands on the table, and two rays of light that looked like substance suddenly shot out from his cloudy eyes.

    "This Ten Thousand Ghosts Tower is the bigger pond. Boy, I don't speak secretly. I have used all channels to check you in the past few days."

    The old ghost got straight to the point, and his voice echoed in the empty attic, "There is no such skilled metal refiner as you in the list of casual cultivators in Linquan County. On the other hand, in Qingyang County next door, when the Lin family was destroyed half a year ago, it is said that a young genius with a golden spirit root came out."

    At this point, the old ghost stared at Chen Fan's mask and said with a smile: "But don't worry, I open the door to do business, only focus on profits and promises, and never ask about the origin of the employer. Those bounties offered by the Immortal Cultivation Family and the Blood Demon Sect are nothing in my eyes."

    Chen Fan neither admits nor denies it.

    He just looked at the old ghost calmly and said calmly: "Since the senior talked about big interests, let's talk about cooperation. The junior needs the highest-level intelligence channels in Linquan County, as well as a way to realize a large number of second-level ores and advanced resources. In exchange, the junior can provide high-quality first-level magic weapon repair and customization for Wangui Tower."
